header: Reviews from teams after a year in production
total_reviews: 182 reviews from workspaces on Build and Scale

reviews.author: Marta Kovač, platform lead at Kestrel Logistics
reviews.title: Delivery notes stopped being a data entry job
reviews.review_text: We moved 240,000 pages a month onto Scale in March 2024. The two people who used to type line items now maintain the mapping rules. The spend cap keeps finance calm.

reviews.author: Jonas Weber, engineering manager at Nordwind Insurance
reviews.title: Accurate, once we paid for the handwriting model
reviews.review_text: Typed claim forms were right from the first afternoon. Handwritten fields only worked after we added the EUR 149 model, which nobody mentioned at signup. Support answered within four hours every time.

reviews.author: Elena Marsh, CTO at Fenwick Health
reviews.title: Redaction made the audit a short conversation
reviews.review_text: Masking happens in the same call as extraction, so nothing unmasked reaches our bucket. Our auditor asked for the seven-year log, and we exported it in an afternoon. That alone is worth EUR 0.006 a page.
